### last time {.smaller}

*  DNS messages
   *  name compression
   *  same format in each direction, query + RRs with counts
   *  sending over UDP, TCP, HTTPS
*  sockets
   *  (protocol, source IP, source port, destination IP, destination port)
      *  can have wildcard values (0.0.0.0, ::)
   *  socket(address family, stream or datagram) --- create socket 
   *  bind() --- set local address
   *  sendto(), recvfrom() --- send/receive (variable remote end)
   *  connect() --- set [default] remote address
   *  send(), recv() --- send/receive (fixed remote end)
